requirements_summary: Workloads: clinical chat (low-latency), document search (embeddings), summarization. Latency target: P50 <= 120ms for short chat responses in EU region; throughput target ~200 req/s for embeddings batch jobs. Model preferences: open-models / quantized Llama-3 variants or Redwood-verified equivalents; ability to pin model version and enforce rollback. Routing/fallback: multi-region fallback to smaller model for burst capacity; automatic fallback to hosted non-sensitive model for non-PHI traffic. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for dedicated capacity if SLA met. Compliance: full HIPAA/BAA required for PHI, SOC 2 Type II & ISO 27001 attestation required, EU data residency for patient data, KMS integration with customer-managed keys (prefer HSM-backed), immutable audit logs with 7+ year retention for clinical traceability. PCI: limited but needs scoping; card data must be out of scope for Redwood-managed storage.
